target.title: Document MiMo reserve evidence contract
target.body:
## Summary

- accepts a fail-closed MiMo reserve evidence contract
- keeps `windowMinutes` and reserve/deficit text absent until an authoritative start, duration, cadence, or token-reset contract exists
- rejects inference from 30/31-day proximity, plan validity, price, or plan-name text
- leaves runtime behavior unchanged and keeps #1205 open for evidence plus a separately reviewed implementation

## Evidence

- Xiaomi publicly offers monthly and annual token plans: https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/token-plan
- the redacted live response documented on #1205 has usage percent and period end, but no start, duration, or cadence discriminator
- closed PR #1310 demonstrated why period-end proximity misclassifies annual plans
- PR #1565 changes MiMo cookie import, not cadence data

## Verification

- `make check`
- documentation links: 144 local links clean
- SwiftFormat: 0/1237 files require formatting
- SwiftLint: 0 violations in 1236 files

Docs only; no UI or runtime behavior changed.
